mapper.insert:
insert into basket_player_season_stat ( season_id, stage_id, team_id, player_id, games, starts, minutes_seconds, points, rebounds, assists, steals, blocks, turnovers, fouls, avg_minutes, avg_points, avg_rebounds, avg_assists, avg_steals, avg_blocks, field_goal_pct, three_point_pct, free_throw_pct, avg_efficiency, double_double_count, triple_double_count, last_calculated_time, create_time, update_time, is_delete ) values
( #{item.seasonId}, #{item.stageId}, #{item.teamId}, #{item.playerId}, #{item.games}, #{item.starts}, #{item.minutesSeconds}, #{item.points}, #{item.rebounds}, #{item.assists}, #{item.steals}, #{item.blocks}, #{item.turnovers}, #{item.fouls}, #{item.avgMinutes}, #{item.avgPoints}, #{item.avgRebounds}, #{item.avgAssists}, #{item.avgSteals}, #{item.avgBlocks}, #{item.fieldGoalPct}, #{item.threePointPct}, #{item.freeThrowPct}, #{item.avgEfficiency}, #{item.doubleDoubleCount}, #{item.tripleDoubleCount}, #{item.lastCalculatedTime}, now(), now(), 0 )
mapper.select: select count(1) from basket_player_season_stat where is_delete = 0 and season_id = #{seasonId}
select max(last_calculated_time) from basket_player_season_stat where is_delete = 0 and season_id = #{seasonId}

select s.id, s.season_id as seasonId, s.stage_id as stageId, s.team_id as teamId, t.team_name as teamName, s.player_id as playerId, p.player_no as playerNo, ifnull(nullif(p.game_nickname, ''), mp.nickname) as displayName, af.access_url as avatarUrl, s.games, s.avg_points as avgPoints, s.avg_rebounds as avgRebounds, s.avg_assists as avgAssists, s.avg_steals as avgSteals, s.avg_blocks as avgBlocks, s.field_goal_pct as fieldGoalPct, s.three_point_pct as threePointPct, s.free_throw_pct as freeThrowPct, s.avg_efficiency as avgEfficiency from basket_player_season_stat s left join basket_team t on t.id = s.team_id and t.is_delete = 0 left join basket_player_profile p on p.id = s.player_id and p.is_delete = 0 left join basket_member_profile mp on mp.member_id = p.member_id and mp.is_delete = 0 left join basket_file_asset af on af.id = mp.avatar_file_id and af.is_delete = 0 where s.is_delete = 0 and s.season_id = #{seasonId} and s.stage_id = #{stageId}
